mil3.1.2:1.3: “Seven what, venerable sir? Are you seven, or is the count seven?”
mil3.1.2:2.1: Now at that time the shadow of King Milinda, who was adorned with every ornament, dressed and arrayed, was visible on the ground, and the shadow was visible in the water jar too.
mil3.1.2:2.2: Then Venerable Nāgasena said to King Milinda—
mil3.1.2:2.3: “This shadow of yours, Great King, is visible on the ground and in the water jar; but now, Great King, are you the king, or is the shadow the king?”
mil3.1.2:2.4: “I am the king, Venerable Nāgasena; this shadow is not the king, but the shadow comes about depending on me.”
mil3.1.2:2.5: “So too, Great King, the count of years is seven, but I am not seven; rather, depending on me, seven comes about—it is like the shadow, Great King.”
mil3.1.2:2.6: “How wonderful, Venerable Nāgasena, how marvelous, Venerable Nāgasena, that such exceedingly ingenious questions have been answered!”
